name: web-giant-thank-you-slide-with-services-list-and-contact-arrows
title: Giant Thank You with Services List
whatItIs: An off-white slide with a full-width black 'Thank You!' in heavy grotesque type sitting on a hairline, a Services heading at left with a right-side list of six services preceded by return arrows, and a footer with a studio line, avatars, email and Telegram contacts and a copyright year.
whatItMeans: Enormous type makes a confident sign-off, and arrows and hairlines make the details feel structured.

vocabulary.definition: A headline set at the full width of the canvas.
An arrow used in place of a list dot.
Overlapping circular portraits of a team.
